posts.html:
Quote from: Chaz on September 03, 2009, 06:38:45 PM
are you actually serious, the allowance of total and utter RDM? Go get checked to see if you have some form of syndrome.

i vote these rules

1) Do not prop kill.
2) Do not prop surf.
3) Only use one layer of prop block per door.
4) Do not kill/mug/steal without roleplay.
5) Do not stat/achievement whore.
6) Do not disconnect to avoid roleplay.
7) Do not hack/exploit.

that means that yes, you can cordon an area and declare it your territory, all trespassers will be shot. and you can do it for large areas - within reason.

true it is not semi serious roleplay, but if you take away all rules to be with killing then it will be no worse than the minges on our lightrp server and so the experiment server will view the same popularity drop.

This + safe zone in the plaza for all killing other then a really good rp reason
